items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I like him. He’s a fine young alto player. Yeah, I think he’s a comer. Plays real good.

ctx.x: Right, that I play and that Bird played. But it’s come back again. A lot of alto players now got that light, very – Gary Bartz. Not Gary Bartz. Kenny Garrett has a very light, airy sound, and so do a lot of alto players out there today.
I like him. He’s a fine young alto player. Yeah, I think he’s a comer. Plays real good.
